recommendations.title: Put the 2023-04-01 Nhava Sheva loads on one truck
recommendations.rationale: 1.93 t → 1.92 t CO₂e, saving 6 kg (0%), with no change to estimated transit.
recommendations.proof: 2 shipments leave through Nhava Sheva on 2023-04-01 and together weigh 24.95 t, which fits the 25.00 t heaviest single load the workbook records — so one truck can carry all 2. Road CO₂e is charged per truck run and not per tonne carried, so running one instead of 2 divides this shipment's 12 kg of road CO₂e by 2. Nothing else about the route changes, and the sailing is untouched.
